summary: [spec fidelity] The allow list gives as its reason that its 8 remote names are the ones a partial clone's fetch of a missing object needs, but git-remote-http (git 2.56.0, strings of the binary) also reads GIT_SSL_CERT, GIT_SSL_KEY, GIT_SSL_CERT_PASSWORD_PROTECTED, GIT_SSL_CERT_TYPE, GIT_SSL_KEY_TYPE, GIT_SSL_VERSION, GIT_SSL_CIPHER_LIST, GIT_HTTP_PROXY_AUTHMETHOD, GIT_HTTP_LOW_SPEED_* and GIT_CURL_VERBOSE. [INFERENCE, no network test run] a client-certificate HTTPS partial clone configured by those variables cannot lazy-fetch under 0.40; GIT_ALLOW_PROTOCOL and a user's GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH are removed too (the wrapper-git probe shows every GIT_* off the list is gone). The human approved the 8 names (default of the question), so this is a note: list the others, or say in the CHANGELOG that the fetch variables are exactly those 8. Not exercised by any check.
